newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya tea prices boosted by strong demand.
newsitem.headline: Kenya tea prices boosted by strong demand.

text.p: Kenyan tea prices were lifted by strong demand at the weekly tea auction on Monday, auction officials said.

Brighter and medium BP1s gained 2-8 U.S. cents while lower mediums were firm to five cents dearer. Brighter PF1s opened firm but eased by 2-5 cents as the sale progressed. Brighter P Dusts were irregular.
Most descriptions in the secondary catalogues were firm to dearer.
Pakistan and Egypt lent good support while there was more interest from Sudan, Yemen and other Middle East countries.
